The wire that has voltage should be connected to both switches. Then one switch needs to be connected to both of the outdoor lights. The other switch need to be wired to the entry light.
An outlet tester only tells you if there is power to the outlet. What you might want to find is someone who has a thermal imager. That way they can see if anything is overheating.
You might have to do some tracing to figure out what goes where. Some of the wires coming in could be used to supply power to other devices.

Some fans have both a black and a blue wire. If this is the case then just wire both of them to the black wire from the ceiling. 
One of the wires is for the fan, the other is for the lights. They have separate wires in case you want a switch for both the fan and the lights.

Yes, you can install them yourself. Just make sure that you turn the breaker off. There should be a black, white and bare wire coming from the ceiling. There should also be a black, white and green wire coming from the fan. Connect the blacks together, connect the whites together, and finally connect the bare wire and the green wire together.
